Resolves #18833

The production app worker builds on webpack 5.111.0 again. The lock moves the transitive `minimizer-webpack-plugin` from 5.8.0 to 5.10.1. 5.10.x is the first line that reads the `as` key 5.111.0 now sends with each inline `<script>` body; 5.8.0 spread that key into terser's options, and terser rejects it. The change is lock-only, with no source or config edits.

Evidence: **L3** — the real `build-threads` command, run from a clean `npm ci` of each lock at the same head `1bba959c90`. AC-2 and AC-3 require L3. AC-4 can only be checked after the merge on the operator's install, so it is listed under Post-Merge Validation.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs ran. Change class: `restoration`.

## AC Evidence

| AC | |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `git diff`: only the `node_modules/minimizer-webpack-plugin` block changes. It goes from 5.8.0 to 5.10.1 and gains four optional `peerDependenciesMeta` entries. No other package changes version |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: `npm run build-threads -- -n -e prod -t app`. On the pre-fix lock it exits 1 with the operator's exact error on `c2dbf450d3b9188847b7.html`; on this lock it exits 0 |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: `npm run build-threads -- -n -e all -t all` on this lock exits 0, with **14/14** compiles |
| AC-4 | post-merge, operator (below) |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

- The red/green pair is one variable at one head. Each lock was installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in a clean worktree, with `bundle-parse5` and `bundle-marked` generated first, because the template loader imports `dist/parse5.mjs`.
- On this lock, the HTML asset the build emits, `bdd9a773197b1416ba97.html`, is **byte-identical** to the one the last good local build (2026-09-09) emitted. The bump restores the old output; it does not change it.
- The minimal repro outside the repo, with the matrix in #18833: 5.110.3 + 5.8.0 green, 5.111.0 + 5.8.0 red, 5.111.0 + 5.10.1 green.
- No CI job would have caught this, because no workflow builds neo's own production threads. That is why #18815 merged green. It is out of scope and recorded in #18833.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Operator: after `npm install`, which pulls `minimizer-webpack-plugin` 5.10.1, `npm run build-all` exits 0.
